text.p: General Motors Corp. said Monday it was recalling 85,000 1997 Buicks and Cadillacs to replace the electronic brake control module or the electronic brake and traction control module after six minor crashes.

Vehicles covered by the recall are Buick Park Avenue and Park Avenue Ultra, Cadillac DeVille, DeVille d'Elegance, DeVille Concours, Eldorado, Eldorado Touring Coupe, Seville Luxury Sedan and Seville Touring Sedan.
GM said an electronic malfunction may cause the braking system to inappropriately apply anti-lock brakes, thus increasing the stopping distance.
To prevent the possibility of the condition occurring, dealers will replace the brake modules at no cost, said GM. Customers will be notified by mail of the recall.
No injuries resulted from the six crashes, according to GM.
